sources.title: Bhoiguda Road under Gandhi Hospital Metro — opposite pedestrian edge — 2026-02
sources.reviewer: Codex authorized Chrome Street View review
sources.notes: Second orientation of the February 2026 panorama previously recorded facing along Bhoiguda Road. It shows a massive Metro pier and soffit, continuous pedestrian railings, a raised brick-paved strip with yellow/black kerb sections, overhead wiring, parked motorcycles and a white-fronted building with glazed lower bays. A large pier blocks most of the frontage and its small colored sign is not readable. A blue-roofed roadside waiting structure/sign is partly visible at the far left but its operator and formal stop identity are unresolved. Reference imagery is not copied.

observations.name: Unresolved white-fronted building behind Metro pier
observations.notes: The view shows white cladding and glazed lower bays on a building across/behind the pedestrian railing. A colored sign at the building edge is partly hidden by the Metro pier and cannot be read reliably; no business name, building ID, entrance, floor, road side or frontage order is assigned.

observations.name: Partly visible blue-roofed roadside waiting structure
observations.notes: A blue-roofed structure with a small blue sign appears at the far left of the panorama near the road edge. The framing does not establish whether this is a formal bus stop, Metro waiting area or another shelter; no operator, exact location or dimensions are inferred.
